name: tls-cert-check
description: 通用域名/证书体检（只读）：HTTPS 可达与状态码、证书剩余天数 ≥ 阈值、证书主题与有效期留档。适合定时或发布后确认 Caddy/Nginx 的证书没掉。

steps.description: HTTPS 可达且状态码 2xx（跟随跳转）

steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
END=$(echo | openssl s_client -connect "${host}:${port}" -servername "${host}" 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -enddate | cut -d= -f2)
[ -n "$END" ] || { echo "cert-read-failed ${host}:${port}（openssl 不可用或握手失败）" >&2; exit 3; }
LEFT=$(( ( $(date -d "$END" +%s) - $(date +%s) ) / 86400 ))
echo "cert-days-left=$LEFT"
[ "$LEFT" -ge ${min_days} ] || { echo "cert-expiring ${host} 剩余 $LEFT 天（阈值 ${min_days}）" >&2; exit 4; }
echo cert-ok

steps.description: 留档：证书主题/颁发者/有效期
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
echo | openssl s_client -connect "${host}:${port}" -servername "${host}" 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates
